added.summary: og.Rng.reset() returns the main stream to its seed's first draw, as a fresh start has it. A game's restart (Retry, Play again) calls it so the restarted world draws what a fresh start draws; until now no call could, so a game that drew from og.Rng could never pass a playtest's `restart` check. Needs og.Rng among the system's writes.
